meta.title: Dynamic time extension (trigger 2 min, extend by 2 min) auction: what each side sees during bidding
gaps: Configure a dynamic time extension with a 2-minute trigger and 2-minute extension; configure_single_stage supports only rank, price, or traffic-light strategies.
Submit Vendor B's bid exactly one minute before the auction ends.
Verify that the end time moves exactly 2 minutes later for everyone, including separate Vendor A and Vendor B portal sessions.
Inspect separate Vendor A and Vendor B screens; the catalog supports only one QA vendor portal session at a time.
Guarantee selection of the requested reverse buy auction template when its exact template name is not provided.

steps.note: Open the single-stage creation flow specified by the case.
Enable eRFX project creation as required by the case.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation as required by the case.
Configure the closest supported auction type; the requested dynamic strategy is not available in the catalog.
Provide the mandatory event title for publishing.
Apply the first offered auction template; the exact reverse buy template cannot be identified without its name.
Add the specified product and quantity.
Populate the auction pricing sheet so the event can be scheduled and published.
Set the requested delivery location on the first line item.
Invite three QA vendors without inventing vendor names.
Confirm that publishing reached a real project page.
Submit the closest available representation of Vendor B's bid at 95; precise one-minute-before-end timing is not supported.
Confirm that the bid was accepted by the vendor portal.
Verify that the buyer's auction Responses view shows the portal bid.
Open the auction activity drawer to inspect whether a dynamic-extension activity entry is present.
Check the activity drawer for the expected dynamic-extension log entry, if the configured behavior produced one.
